ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 65% low-intensity (black/dark grey) to 35% high-intensity (white/light grey). Pigmentation is characterized by large, solid dark medial regions with high-contrast white distal extremities.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant black pigment blocks occupy the interior area of both lobes. Distinct white regions are located on the lateral tips. The right lobe distal white region (image right) contains a single isolated dark circular spot and minor mottling. The left lobe distal white region (image left) contains a similar dark circular spot and several thin, vertical dark linear streaks.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Highly irregular and jagged trailing edge. The right lobe exhibits high-frequency sawtooth peaks near the medial region. The left lobe displays a significant high-amplitude indentation (approx. 15% depth of fluke height) roughly one-third of the distance from the lateral tip.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: The trailing edge follows a general convex curve from the obscured notch to the distal tips, significantly modified by deep, irregular serrations.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense clusters of roughly circular, high-contrast, elevated white pixel groups (barnacle colonization) are concentrated at the extreme distal tips and along the anterior-lateral margins of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple high-contrast white linear streaks (rake marks) are visible across the black pigment on both lobes. The right lobe medial-distal quadrant shows at least three distinct parallel vertical lines.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive irregular trailing edge serrations and significant tissue-loss indentations on the left lobe lobe indicating past physical trauma. Prominent barnacle colonization on the distal margins.
other_distinctive_markers: Matching focal dark circular spots located within the white pigmentation zones of both the left and right distal lobe tips.
